summary: Ellington Credit Company filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on November 5, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Trustees declared a monthly common distribution of $0.08 per share, payable December 31, 2026 to holders of record as of November 30, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation beyond the declaration is stated. The filing is a routine dividend announcement accompanied by the press release as Exhibit 99.1, with no transactional mechanics, ownership changes or regulatory clock. What to watch: distribution sustainability relative to earnings and book value, not a deal-arbitrage situation.
